headline: Remittance income exceeds US$10,598 million in 10 months
summary: Remittances to the Dominican Republic reached $1,108.6 million in October, up 14.8% from a year earlier. January to October inflows totaled $10,598.4 million, according to the central bank.
why: Remittances are a major source of foreign currency and household income in the Dominican Republic, so they shape the balance of payments and domestic consumption.
original_headline: Ingresos por remesas superan los US$10,598 millones en 10 meses
